approved_scope.title: Delta validation reads a living requirement's block as the materializer does
approved_scope.description: Delta validation reads a living requirement's block as the materializer does
approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: Makes delta validation match REQ-change-048 and REQ-change-049: an ADDED requirement already present with the same content is applied, not a conflict. Validation now reads the living block the way the materializer does, ending at the next heading of level 3 or shallower. The change spec only lists the new test file.
acceptance_criteria: An ADDED requirement whose text is unchanged in the living requirements.md validates when a ## section follows it, and the applier reads the same block as applied; a different body under the same id is still refused as cannot add existing block (red then green)
